positioning.role: A school management platform that delivers dedicated digital applications to multiple schools.
positioning.not: A generic SaaS tool. Shafeea is a multi-tenant platform where each school receives its own branded environment, with features released centrally and deployed per-school.
positioning.website_scope: Institutional presence of the Shafeea school platform. Hosts the school registration portal, the CMS-powered newsroom, and the per-school template engine.
positioning.description: Shafeea is the school management platform that connects teachers, students, and school administrators through purpose-built applications — enabling Quran tracking, scheduling, enrollment, and school communications across a multi-school network.

positioning.role: The dedicated teacher-facing application for school staff.
positioning.description: The Shafeea Teacher App gives school staff the tools to manage student groups, track Quran memorization progress, record attendance, and communicate with school administration — all from a purpose-built mobile experience.

positioning.role: The dedicated student-facing application for school learners.
positioning.description: The Shafeea Student App provides learners with access to their Quran tracking records, lesson schedules, progress reports, and school notifications — delivering a focused and accessible experience tailored to the student journey.
